verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP feature lets users query feedback via LLM to surface top themes and ARR impact across ideas, which supports decluttering/prioritizing raw feedback (canny-docs-4). Autopilot also captures untracked feedback into the system (canny-docs-6). However, evidence is entirely vendor-marketing with no hands-on/independent validation of accuracy or effectiveness, and no dedicated 'AI insights/analytics' dashboard is documented beyond MCP querying. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of AI-driven theme surfacing quality, a first-party analytics/insights UI showing AI-clustered feedback, and evidence of ARR-impact scoring accuracy.
